question: In the AIDev reviewer-objection set (eval/aidev_recall_cases.json, readable rows of results/aidev_recall_v6.json), how often did a reviewer object to the same file path in two or more different agent pull requests of the same repository? That is the case the Decided before line is for.
registered: 2026-10-22, before counting; the counting script is written after this file is committed
unit: a (repository, path) pair with objections in at least two different pull requests
report: pairs with objections in 2+ pull requests
objections that were a repeat (every one after the first per pair)
share of all readable objections that were a repeat, Wilson 95%
the raw pairs with their comment links
limits: Only objections the phrase search found; a later pull request that brought the file back without an objection is not counted (the cache has no file lists for those), so this undercounts repeats. Path match only; a renamed file is a different path.
